app.name: happn: dating app
app.description: A location-based dating app that helps you find people you've crossed paths with in real life.

verdict.one_liner: happn tracks your real-world location to show you people you've crossed paths with, but it shares your data with social networks for advertising and uses facial recognition to verify profiles.
verdict.summary: happn is a location-based dating app from France that uses your real-world location to match you with people you've crossed paths with. While it keeps messages private and doesn't handle payment data, it tracks extensive activity data, shares your email and phone with social networks for ad targeting, uses facial recognition for profile verification, and requires a face photo to register.
verdict.recommendation_reason: happn's core feature requires extensive location tracking and it shares your contact information with social networks for advertising. Consider whether the real-world matching feature is worth the privacy trade-offs.

red.title: Tracks your real-world location continuously
red.plain_english: happn records your geographical position regularly to find other members you've crossed paths with in real life. Your crossing points are displayed on your profile and on a map.

red.title: Shares your data with social networks for ads
red.plain_english: happn shares your email address and phone number with social networks like Facebook to show you ads on those platforms and to find new users who look like you. This is done with your consent, but it's still sharing your personal data with big tech companies.

red.title: Uses facial recognition to verify profiles
red.plain_english: happn collects biometric data from a video of your face to verify that your profile photo is really you. The video is stored on their servers so they can re-verify you if you change your photos.

red.title: Requires a face photo to register
red.plain_english: You cannot create a happn account without uploading a clear photo of your face. Their systems automatically detect faces in photos and will reject your registration if they can't find one.

red.title: AI analyzes your behavior to recommend profiles
red.plain_english: happn uses artificial intelligence to analyze your activity, location, and profile information to recommend other members you might like. This means your behavior is constantly being analyzed by algorithms.

green.title: Messages are private and not shared
green.plain_english: happn stores your chat messages and voice messages on their servers, but they are strictly private. happn's staff cannot view your conversations, and messages are only shared if legally required.

green.title: Does not handle your payment data
green.plain_english: happn never sees your credit card or banking information. All payments go through Apple or Google, and happn only receives a transaction number to validate the purchase.

green.title: Full GDPR data rights available
green.plain_english: As a French company, happn complies with European privacy laws and gives you rights to access, correct, delete, and export your personal data.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: You must upload a photo of your face to create an account. happn uses the camera for profile photos and optional video calls. Video calls are only available after a mutual match.
categories.detail: Mandatory profile photo containing a recognizable face. Face detection used during registration. Optional video calls between matched members.
categories.policy_excerpt: your first name, age, birthdate, gender, and at least one Profile Photo are required to register... You will not be able to create an account if your face cannot be detected in one of your Profile Photos upon registering.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: happn's main feature is tracking your location to show you people you've crossed paths with in real life. Your location is collected regularly and your crossing points are displayed on your profile and a map.
categories.detail: Geolocation collected regularly with consent. Crossing points displayed on profile and map. Exact location never shown to other members. City required if geolocation refused.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your Geographical position is collected with your express consent only... HAPPN will collect your Geographical position regularly. When the Geographical positions of two Members are within a certain radius, HAPPN pinpoints a Crossing point.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: happn does not ask for or access your phone's contacts list.
categories.detail: No mention of contacts or phonebook access in privacy policy.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You must upload at least one photo of your face from your device's storage to create a profile. You can add more photos if you want.
categories.detail: Photo upload required for registration. Additional photos optional. Photos analyzed for face detection.
categories.policy_excerpt: at least one Profile Photo containing a person's face are required to register with the Application... As stated in paragraph 1, the first Profile Photo should be a photo of a person's face, otherwise one of your photos of your face will automatically be put in first position.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: happn shares your public profile with all other members. It also shares your email and phone number with social networks for advertising purposes, and works with third-party service providers.
categories.detail: Profile data visible to other members. Email/phone shared with social networks for ad targeting (with consent). Third-party service providers used. Apple/Google handle payments.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may share you email address and telephone number with such entities to exclude you from our Marketing campaigns... The social networks which may receive your data for this purpose appear in the list of our service providers.
concerns: Data shared with social networks for ads

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: happn requires your first name, age, gender, and a face photo. They can also collect your identity document or biometric data to verify your age or certify your profile. Your profile is visible to all members.
categories.detail: Requires first name, age, gender, face photo. Optional identity document verification. Biometric data collected for profile certification (with consent). Face detection required for registration.
categories.policy_excerpt: HAPPN reserves the right, subject to your consent, to conduct facial image capture or verify an identity document at the time of registration or during use of the Service... we must collect the his or her biometric data using a video of his or her face, and compare this data with the Member's Profile Photos.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: happn tracks everything you do in the app, including who you like, who you message, and where you go. They use this data to show you personalized ads and recommend profiles, and they share your data with social networks for advertising.
categories.detail: Tracks all activity (likes, messages, crossings, transactions). AI recommendations. Personalized ads based on age/gender/location (with consent). Marketing emails. Data shared with social networks for ad targeting.
categories.policy_excerpt: Activity data (registration date, login dates, on or offline status, interactions with Members and third-party accounts, number of transactions, notifications received, notification preferences, etc.)... we conduct marketing operations and advertising outside of the HAPPN application outside of third-party sites, social networks and third-party applications.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: happn is strictly for adults 18 and older. They verify age in some countries using identity documents.
categories.detail: Terms require users to be at least 18. Age verification conducted in certain jurisdictions using identity documents.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Member must be over the age of 18... HAPPN verifies that users have reached the age of majority, based on an identity document or any other legally accepted proof of age.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: happn collects your IP address, server logs, app crash data, and language settings when you use the app.
categories.detail: IP address, server logs, application version, language, operating system, application crashes collected.
categories.policy_excerpt: IP, mobile ID, application version, telephone version and model, language used, operating system, application crashes, and advertisement ID. Data may be collected with cookies or other tracking tools.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: happn collects detailed information about your device including your mobile ID, device model, operating system, and advertising ID. These identifiers can be used to track your device across apps.
categories.detail: Collects mobile ID, device version and model, OS, language, advertisement ID, application version.
categories.policy_excerpt: Technical data of the cell phone or device (IP, mobile ID, application version, telephone version and model, advertisement ID, etc.)... Data may be collected with cookies or other tracking tools.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: happn collects biometric data from a video of your face to verify your profile photo is really you. They also use face detection to make sure you upload a real face photo when registering. The video is stored on their servers.
categories.detail: Biometric data collected for profile certification (video of face compared with photos). Face detection required for registration. Video stored for re-verification if photos change.
categories.policy_excerpt: HAPPN must, having obtained the Member's consent, collect the his or her biometric data using a video of his or her face, and compare this data with the Member's Profile Photos... the video will be stored in order to reverify the Member's profile should he or she add or delete other photos.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: happn never sees your credit card or banking information. All purchases go through Apple or Google, and happn only receives a transaction number to confirm the purchase.
categories.detail: Apple/Google handle all payments. Happn retains purchase/subscription history but no payment method information.
categories.policy_excerpt: HAPPN does not collect or process any banking data. Apple's App Store and Google's Play Store have opted to refrain from sending certain types data to mobile applications, which includes any banking and financial information.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your happn account at any time. As a European company, happn gives you rights to access, correct, and export your personal data under GDPR.
categories.detail: Account deletion available. GDPR rights mentioned (access, rectification, erasure, portability). Contact support for data rights.
categories.policy_excerpt: Should the Member not agree with changes made to the TOS, he or she has the option to end the Services and delete his or her Account as per Article 14.3.
concerns: No explicit mention of immediate deletion timeline

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: happn can change its terms at any time and will notify you through the app or by email. If you keep using the app after changes, that means you accept them.
categories.detail: Notified via app and/or email. Continued use constitutes acceptance. Member can delete account if they disagree.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Member will be informed of updates to the TOS via the Application and/or by email... Complete acceptance of the changes is implied by the Member's continued use of the Application's Services following the updates.
